title: Elixir of Dwarven Resilience
summary: Add your proficiency bonus to saving throws until you succeed on three saves or finish a Long Rest.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Add your proficiency bonus to saving throws until you succeed on three saves or finish a Long Rest.
fields.Acquisition: Trade dwarf or duergar blood to Araj Oblodra in Moonrise Towers or the Lower City.
fields.Stacking: Araj’s elixirs stack with ordinary elixirs and other Araj elixirs.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
